summary: customer_case retest: Next.js static-export build fix verified. 3 new checks covering the acceptance_matrix (prod build output, static-file serving, live preview + contact submission), all passing. Re-ran full backend suite (8 passed) as a regression guard.

checks.criterion: Production frontend build produces the directory the deploy pipeline copies (build/ or dist/)
checks.name: manual-build-verification (not a browser/backend artifact; recorded here per matrix item)
checks.evidence: Copied /app/frontend (excluding node_modules/.next/build/out) to /tmp/fe2, symlinked node_modules, ran `NODE_ENV=production yarn build` -> exit 0, 'Exporting (2/2)' success. /tmp/fe2/build/ contains index.html, _next/ (static chunks), explorer/evar/index.html, contact/index.html, admin/index.html, services/hepatobiliary/index.html. Workspace cleaned up (/tmp/fe2 removed) after verification; did not touch running dev server's .next.

checks.criterion: Exported static site works when served as plain files
checks.name: static-export-serves-pages
checks.evidence: Served /tmp/fe2/build via `python -m http.server 8899`; curl on /, /explorer/evar/, /contact/ all returned 200. Browser check loaded all three paths: hero-3d-canvas visible on /, procedure-explorer visible on /explorer/evar/, consult-form visible on /contact/; console_errors: [] (no stray errors even with no backend present).

checks.criterion: Live preview unaffected by the config change

checks.criterion: Regression guard: existing backend test suite
